summary_for_children: Ar-Ra'd shows rivers, gardens, lightning and thunder as signs of Allah, and compares truth to water that stays and falsehood to foam that goes away.
environment_concept: A mountain valley of rivers, gardens side by side, lightning and thunder, and a flood that leaves foam behind.
architecture_and_scenery: River valley between mountains, terraced neighbouring plots, palm groves, storm clouds.

areas.name: Neighbouring Plots
areas.description: Plots side by side growing different fruits from one water.

areas.name: Thunder Hall
areas.description: A great rock hall where thunder echoes.

areas.name: Foam Pool
areas.description: A pool where foam drifts away and water remains.

activities.name: Water and foam
activities.description: Let floodwater settle: foam floats away, useful water stays.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: One water, many fruits
activities.description: Water neighbouring plots and see different fruits grow.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator reads each sign's ayah when it appears.
learning_objectives: Explain the example of water and foam

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
